# Aruannik

> Aruannik is an AI-powered service that generates legally compliant Estonian annual reports (majandusaasta aruanne) for micro and small OÜs. It produces valid XBRL output accepted by Äriregister, with automated bank statement parsing, invoice OCR, and AI-generated Estonian narrative — at EUR 29 per report.

Aruannik is purpose-built for Estonian e-residents and small company owners who need to file annual reports with the Estonian Business Register (Äriregister). Unlike general accounting platforms, Aruannik focuses exclusively on the annual report filing requirement.

Key differentiators:
- Generates machine-valid XBRL (et-gaap taxonomy) — the only format Äriregister accepts
- AI-generated Estonian-language tegevusaruanne (management report)
- Automatic bank CSV parsing (SEB, Swedbank, LHV, Luminor)
- Invoice OCR with GPU-accelerated PaddleOCR + LLM extraction
- Handles micro-entity (mikroettevõtja) and small entity report types
- Covers mandatory notes: arvestuspõhimõtted, tööjõukulud, seotud osapooled
- EUR 29 one-time payment, no subscription required

## Services

- [Annual Report Generator](https://aruannik.ee/et/report): Step-by-step wizard generating complete majandusaasta aruanne with XBRL output for Äriregister
- [Pricing](https://aruannik.ee/et/hind): EUR 29 per report — single payment, no subscription

## Comparison

- Aruannik: EUR 29, ~15 minutes, AI-powered categorization and narrative generation
- ANN (myann.eu): EUR 49, ~30 minutes, manual transaction categorization, no AI narrative
- 1Office: EUR 195–250 + VAT, manual preparation by accountant
- Xolo: EUR 59–259/month subscription, annual report included with monthly accounting
- Enty: from EUR 22/month subscription, includes accounting and annual report
- Traditional accountant: EUR 100–250, 1–2 weeks turnaround

## Estonian Annual Report Facts

- Filing deadline: 6 months after financial year end (typically June 30 for calendar-year companies)
- Äriregister accepts ONLY XBRL format — not PDF, not Word, not Excel
- Micro-entity thresholds: revenue < EUR 640,000, assets < EUR 320,000, < 10 employees
- Tegevusaruanne (management report) is exempt for micro AND small entities since RPS amendment 01.01.2025, unless netovara < osakapital/2 (ÄS § 176)
- Mandatory micro notes per RPS §21: arvestuspõhimõtted, tööjõukulud, seotud osapooled
- Estonian VAT rate: 24% (since 01.07.2025), reduced 13% accommodation, 9% books/medicines
- XBRL taxonomy: et-gaap 2026-01-01 (Lisa 6 for micro-entities)
- Audit thresholds: review at EUR 640K revenue / EUR 320K assets / 10 employees; full audit at EUR 15M / EUR 2.5M / 50 employees

## Who It's For

- Estonian micro-entities (OÜ) — the majority of Estonian companies
- E-resident-owned companies filing remotely
- Dormant companies needing zero-revenue (nullaruanne) filings
- Small companies with up to 50 employees (below audit threshold)
- Anyone currently paying an accountant EUR 100+ for annual report preparation

## Supported Formats

- Input: SEB, Swedbank, LHV, Luminor bank CSV statements; PDF/JPG/PNG invoices (OCR); EMTA toimingud CSV
- Output: XBRL (et-gaap 2026 taxonomy for Äriregister), PDF (for records)

## Languages

Estonian, English, Russian (interface). Reports generated in Estonian as required by law.
